### Motivation

run examples/agents/mcp_agent/mcp_agent_using_registry.py with strict mode would get error:
```
camel.models.model_manager.ModelProcessingError: Unable to process messages: the only provided model did not run successfully. Error: Error code: 400 - {'error': {'message': "Invalid schema for function 'ACI_EXECUTE_FUNCTION': In context=(), 'required' is required to be supplied and to be an array including every key in properties. Extra required key 'function_arguments' supplied.", 'type': 'invalid_request_error', 'param': 'tools[1].function.parameters', 'code': 'invalid_function_parameters'}}
```
